marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 20 knots diminishing to light near midnight then
increasing to northwest 20 Saturday morning. Scattered flurries changing to snow this evening.
Visibility 1 mile or less in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
